plain_english_policy: Enactment would expand access to prepaid college tuition plans across all Alabama public institutions while stabilizing program finances through stricter investment rules and fee controls.
policy_direction_if_enacted: The bill repeals cost limits on specific PACT contracts, allowing payments tied directly to current semester rates rather than fixed caps. It extends these protections statewide by applying tuition caps uniformly to any college or university in the state. Financial stability is prioritized via a 60/40 equity-to-income investment split and mandates that annual fee increases cannot exceed the average growth over the prior decade.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representative Ford (Ways and Means Education) advanced this as a fiscal responsibility measure to restore public trust in PACT while broadening its reach.
evidence_quotes: This bill would repeal the limit on the cost of tuition for certain PACT plan contract participants.
This bill would extend tuition caps to all colleges and universities in the state.
PACT investments would be limited to no more than 60 percent equity investments.
require all public institutions to limit annual increases in fees to the average percentage amount such fees were increased over the past 10 years.
